top_findings: Meta Android is the best home for the next dollar: next-dollar ROAS 1.77 against a scale line of 1.29. It steps up 20% a week to 5391 in week 4.
Meta iOS: the extra 3600 spent in the late half bought 550 more installs at 6.55 each, above the iOS max CPI of 4.08. Trim it back to 4500 a week; its average still pays back.
TikTok iOS: projected payback ROAS 0.91, short of 1.18. Cut it to 770 a week, and refresh the creative: CPI rose 15.6% on only 4.8% more spend.
TikTok Android installs are worth 0.19 by day 7 against the Android average of 0.5; projected payback ROAS 0.7. Pause it.
Snapchat iOS can't be judged: it is not in the measurement partner. Integrate it in the next 2 weeks or it stops.
Open Google App campaigns on iOS next: a 6013 two-week test on trial starts at 42.95 each fits in the 29974 left under the cap.
